task.name: Host_scheduled_artist
task.when: Starting 30 minutes before each scheduled artist's set and ending after handoff to the next artist

step.action: Read the current artist's set time and 🌐 Artist_Rider.
Confirm with the sound team that the rider's approved technical needs are ready.
Locate the artist at least 30 minutes before the set.
step.ifThen: IF the artist cannot be located, THEN tell the Music Lead, Dominatrix, and sound team and ask the current artist or on-call camp DJ to cover only when the Music Lead approves.

step.action: Greet the artist and introduce them to the sound team.
Offer the artist drinking water from 🍳 Drinking_Water_Dispensers.
Offer the artist the current wine and cheese pairing.
step.ifThen: IF the artist accepts, THEN have the active Bar and Cheese workers complete 📋 Serve_wine and 📋 Serve_cheese_pairing.

step.action: Ask the artist whether they need another approved rider item.
Start 🌐 DJ_Recorder before the set begins.
Record the actual set start time.
Remain available near the artist without taking a bar assignment.
Locate the next artist before the current set ends.
Record the actual set end time.
Thank the artist and offer water and an optional 🏕️ Buffer_Bush visit.

passWhen.criterion: The artist was introduced to the sound team and received approved hospitality support.
The set recording contains the actual start and end times.
The next artist or approved substitute was ready before handoff.

reasoning.entry: Named people from the source checklist are replaced by stable Music Lead and Dominatrix roles.
The pairing gift is routed through the existing age-verification and food-service tasks; the undefined nicer-bottle gift remains omitted until the camp approves a product and handoff method.
